reason: A browser-side theme customization plugin that sets an uploaded image as the web UI background and provides overlay, opacity, blur, color adaptation, and persistent local settings.

summaries.zh: 用于将用户上传的图片设置为 Web 界面背景壁纸，并调整遮罩、透明度和模糊效果的主题插件。
summaries.en: A theme plugin that sets a user-uploaded image as the Web interface background and provides overlay, opacity, and blur controls.

capabilities: uploads a user-selected image as a web page background
adjusts background overlay, opacity, and blur
stores wallpaper settings and image data in browser localStorage
overrides interface theme tokens while active
